name: Ahiman
overview: The name Ahiman appears in Scripture referring to two distinct individuals: first, as one of the Anakim giants inhabiting Hebron, whom Caleb and the Israelites drove out during the conquest of Canaan, highlighting God's provision in overcoming formidable enemies (Numbers 13:22; Joshua 15:14). Second, Ahiman is identified as a Levite porter, entrusted with temple duties, signifying faithful service in God's house (1 Chronicles 9:17). These references together illustrate both the challenges faced by Israel from powerful adversaries and the dedicated roles within the community of God's people.
